modelInput.question: Using a demand and supply diagram, explain the effect of the drought on the equilibrium price and quantity of wheat. [4 marks]
modelInput.answer: The drought reduces the wheat harvest, so producers can supply less wheat at each price. Supply shifts left from S1 to S2 while demand stays unchanged. At the original price P1 there is a shortage. Buyers compete for the reduced supply and the price rises to P2. As price rises, quantity demanded falls along D. The new equilibrium therefore has a higher wheat price and a lower quantity traded, Q2 rather than Q1.
